text:
emily: Heads up 3 noticed ~1.8% of leads created between 10:50-12:30 UTC never got an owner in HS/SF. Looks like router returned 'no-route' when enrichment lingered past 30s. Can we triage?

rob: I saw that too. Stack traces show enrichment-service had intermittent 504s + the demux logic treats "pending" as non-routable after timeout.

ops-bot: Alert: enrichment-service latency spike (p95=48s) at 11:15 UTC.

sam: Quick inventory: current behavior -> hold_for_enrich -> eventually no-route if timer expires. No overflow fallback. That matches the missed outbound touches call from SDRs.

joan: Are these sent to DLQ? If not we need a retro flag to audit SLA.

emily: Not DLQ3 they land in HS but with no owner property set so automation never claims them.

rob: Suggestion: implement a short-circuit 'overflow_hotline' assign after N seconds (configurable). Also populate hs_pending_enrich_ts and hs_handoff_tag = "overflow_hotline" so reporting can filter.

vishal: Love that. Also add a webhook heartbeat and a small window where router waits for enrichment callback before triggering fallback. e.g. wait 8s, then fallback if still pending, then retry enrichment backoff 15s/45s.

Code sketch:
```
if (now - metadata.enrich_started > fallback_after_seconds) {
  assignOverflow('overflow_hotline')
  setMeta('handoff_tag', 'overflow_hotline')
} else {
  keepWaiting()
}
```

sam: I'll map the HubSpot fields. Proposed mapping:
metadata.enrich_started -> hs_pending_enrich_ts
metadata.handoff_tag -> hs_handoff_tag
metadata.fallback_reason -> hs_handoff_reason

joan: I'll run a 48h audit today to quantify impact. SQL draft:
```
SELECT count(*), hs_handoff_tag
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours'
AND owner_id IS NULL
GROUP BY hs_handoff_tag;
```
I'll post numbers in an hour.

emily: Action list: rob implement fallback + feature flag marketing.hotline_fallback, sam update HS mapping and workflows, joan run audit, marco ping SDRs for temporary workflow adjustments.

marco: I'll notify SDR channel 3 heads up that a small volume may go to overflow_hotline during the canary.

rob: Plan: open PR tonight with feature flag, tests for race between enrichment callback and fallback, and a short-circuit assign to overflow pool. PR stub: github.com/redwood/lead-router/pull/842 (will update).

ops-bot: Incident created: #marketing-inbound-hotline-3051234567.

vishal: One more: add metrics for fallback_rate and callback_race_count so we know if fallback is masking enrichment regressions.

emily: Agreed. If we can land the flag + HS mapping by tomorrow morning we can run an overnight canary and roll back if noisy. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
